g.text: Figure 2 · From local patterns to global activity polarity
Continued review sheet 2 of 2 · source-map cells 1/2/3 match the histories and vector curves below
1→2 changes size/material/architecture/routes. Only 2→3 moves the cue in the identical full basal state.
Cue off at 1000; histories show 0–4000, outcomes at 14,000. Gray denotes space outside C30; periodic cut keeps incumbent at 0 intact.
P = M₁(t)/M₁(0): initial (1,0); magnitude can exceed 1. Squares: cue off; triangles: t4000.
A weak resultant can reflect cancellation: antipodal Holmes retains two sites and nearly unchanged total Rac. See linked full-vector component.
Single peak near old; identity unresolved
